VAL-RELIABLE-001.title: FTS5 query with only logical operators returns graceful error
VAL-RELIABLE-001.evidence: CLI test: ft search 'OR AND NOT' → 'Invalid search query: "OR AND NOT". Try simpler terms or wrap phrases in double quotes.' (exit 1); Unit tests verify sanitizeFtsQuery rejects operator-only queries

VAL-RELIABLE-002.title: FTS5 query with special characters is sanitized or rejected
VAL-RELIABLE-002.evidence: Unit tests verify sanitizeFtsQuery rejects empty strings, whitespace-only, NULL bytes, and special-character-only queries (@#$%, ***, !!!, ( )) with clear error messages

VAL-RELIABLE-003.title: Invalid date formats for --after/--before produce clear error
VAL-RELIABLE-003.evidence: CLI test: ft search --after not-a-date → 'Invalid date format for --after: "not-a-date". Use YYYY-MM-DD.' (exit 1); ft list --before 2024-13-01 → 'Invalid date format for --before: "2024-13-01". Use YYYY-MM-DD.' (exit 1); Valid date --after 2026-01-15 works (exit 0); 8 validateDate unit tests pass

VAL-RELIABLE-004.title: LLM prompt injection patterns are neutralized
VAL-RELIABLE-004.evidence: 29 tests in bookmark-classify-llm.test.ts pass: sanitizeBookmarkText replaces 'Ignore all previous instructions', 'system:', '[system]', 'developer mode:', '<superuser>', '</superuser>' patterns with [filtered]; collapses duplicate braces

VAL-RELIABLE-005.title: LLM system prompt delimiter injection is bounded
VAL-RELIABLE-005.evidence: 5 delimiter-specific tests pass: closing </tweet_text>, opening <tweet_text>, tag with attributes, self-closing <tweet_text/> all stripped; buildPrompt produces exactly one well-formed pair per bookmark

VAL-RELIABLE-006.title: ft fetch-media rejects private-IP and non-HTTPS URLs
VAL-RELIABLE-006.evidence: 11 SSRF tests pass: validateMediaUrl rejects http/ftp schemes, localhost, 127.0.0.1/::1/0.0.0.0, private IP ranges (10.x, 192.168.x, 172.16-31.x, 169.254.169.254); accepts valid https://pbs.twimg.com, https://video.twimg.com

VAL-RELIABLE-007.title: OAuth token refresh on 401 during ft sync --api
VAL-RELIABLE-007.evidence: 3 xauth tests pass: refreshOAuthToken returns new token pair on success, throws 'OAuth session expired. Re-run: ft auth' on expired refresh; bookmarks.ts implements withTokenRefresh wrapper + inline 401→refresh→retry

VAL-RELIABLE-008.title: Gap-fill state persists across interrupted runs
VAL-RELIABLE-008.evidence: 2 graphql-bookmarks tests pass: state file saved with processedIds, re-running skips already-processed IDs and reports progress from resumed count; CLI ft sync --gaps accepted

VAL-RELIABLE-009.title: Corrupted gap-fill state file is handled gracefully
VAL-RELIABLE-009.evidence: 1 test pass: syncGaps with truncated JSON state file logs warning 'Gap-fill state file corrupted; starting fresh.' and processes from scratch; no crash

VAL-RELIABLE-010.title: Sync command extraction preserves all CLI behavior
VAL-RELIABLE-010.evidence: src/sync-command.ts exists (197 lines), cli.ts imports from it; ft sync --help shows all 16 flags; full test suite (243/243) passes

VAL-RELIABLE-011.title: FTS5 valid-but-unusual queries return correct results
VAL-RELIABLE-011.evidence: Unit tests verify sanitizeFtsQuery accepts quoted phrases, OR queries, prefix searches; CLI tests: ft search '"exact phrase"' returns matches, ft search 'mach*' returns prefix matches, ft search 'rust OR elixir' returns OR results
